lines.en: I run, all four limbs working.
I don't understand this speed either.

lines.zh: 我的身体折成一段一段。
lines.en: My body folds into segments.

lines.zh: 我从树上一跃，落到地上。
lines.en: I leap from a tree and land.
My feet land and the grass flattens.
I don't go around anything.
Walls I climb straight over.

lines.zh: 我手脚并用，爬上那面砖墙。
lines.en: I scramble up that brick wall on all fours.
Wind pulls past my head.

lines.zh: 我的脊背压低，速度还在涨。
lines.en: My spine lowers, and my speed keeps climbing.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我追得越近。
lines.en: The harder you gasp, the closer I get.
That speed isn't enough.
I stop. Not from tiredness.
I'm listening for where you've got to.

lines.zh: 这个速度，我停不住太久。
lines.en: At this speed I can't stay still long.
My legs shake. Held back.
A few more steps to run.
Your steps. I'm counting them.
The moment I stop, I want to move.
Bones click. All of them.
Run. I won't be stopping.
There's no one else here.
I'm waiting to count to zero.
I'm nearly on you.

lines.zh: 我四肢反折，贴在天花板上。
lines.en: My limbs bend backward, clinging to the ceiling.
One moment. I haven't started.
Once I run, I don't stop.
Then there's no point hiding.
I'm starting now.
You'd better be running.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我的声音很难听。
lines.en: I don't shout. My voice is bad.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一下，浪费了半秒。
lines.en: Looking back cost you half a second.
Half a second. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就从旁边过去。
lines.en: You reach. I go past your side.
You vault the fence. I don't.
A fence won't stop me. I go through.
Listen. My steps are fast.
My steps are faster than yours.
You can't keep running that long.
All night. I can.
All night, I can.

lines.zh: 我已经跑起来了，不会停。
lines.en: I'm running now, and I won't stop.
I'm chasing it, and you.
It gets there first. You after.
I chase the shadow. I arrive last.
And then I stop chasing.

lines.zh: 我慢了半拍，马上补回来。
lines.en: I lost half a beat and got it back.
That doesn't change my speed.
I veered. I didn't stop.
You hit me. It does nothing.

lines.zh: 我身上没多少东西可以打坏。
lines.en: There isn't much of me left to break.
I back two steps and start running again.
This much I forget once I'm running.
You hit me, but my stride does not break.
I'll catch up at once.
Don't think that shakes me off.
I've no reason to stop.
Throw things. I won't pick them up.

lines.zh: 你在换手的时候慢了一点。
lines.en: You slowed when you switched hands.

lines.zh: 你换手时慢了，我瞧见了。
lines.en: You slowed switching hands. I saw it.
Dropping it would make you lighter.
But you can't bear to.
You can't bear to drop it. Better still.
I don't need to eat. I only need to chase.
Keep carrying it.
It's slowing you down.
You hit me and bounced back.
I run. I don't slow.
I hit the fence. The fence broke.
You're in my path. Dangerous.

lines.zh: 我侧了一下身，就过去了。
lines.en: I tilt and I'm past.
Your shoulder met my leg.
I run steady. I don't trip.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我就贴上去。
lines.en: You back to the wall. I press in.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，你打了个趔趄。
lines.en: We brushed and you stumbled.
Don't cut across my path.

lines.zh: 我现在的速度，不适合这个。
lines.en: At this speed I'm not suited to that.
You'd have to keep up.
Fall behind and you're left.
I run. I don't stop.
How long can you run?
I don't need to ask that.
I'll run with you till dawn.
Until you stop.
Then I stop too.
Just that once. Only that once.

lines.zh: 我不为地上的东西折腰。
lines.en: I never stoop for things on the ground.
I run over it and crush it.
Anything in the way gets that.
You dropped something and looked back.
In that half second I closed fifteen feet.
Feel free to keep picking things up.
Pick it up. I don't mind.
There's plenty more on the ground.
Plenty more on the ground. Take your time.

lines.zh: 我蹲在梁上，看你捡东西。
lines.en: I crouch on the beam and watch you pick it up.

lines.zh: 我的指节扣进泥土，起跑。
lines.en: My knuckles dig into the dirt—I launch.
The ground sounds under me.
One stride, thirty feet.
You heard it and started running.
Exactly what I want.
That makes it interesting.
I can keep this up.
You're running straight.
A straight line is quickest. And easiest to follow.
You turned. That costs speed.
Turning costs speed.
I didn't slow.
One turn, and I'm closer.
Turn once more. I'd like to see.
I'd like to see that.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我的关节就响了。
lines.en: The moment you turn, my joints crack.
I follow. I don't fall behind.
You jump. I jump.
You climb. I climb faster.
You go into water. So do I.
In water I'm a little slower.

lines.zh: 水里的我更慢，可你更慢。
lines.en: Slower in water — but you're slower still.
You're on the roof.
I go up the wall.
You climb the ladder; I cling to its foot.
Now I'm above.
You're running. Your steps are ragged.
The more your breath races, the steadier I am.
You're gasping. I'm not.

lines.zh: 你握火把的手，抖得厉害。
lines.en: The hand holding your torch is shaking badly.

lines.zh: 你每回一次头，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Every time you look back, I gain an inch.
Each time I'm closer.
Ten steps behind you.
Five steps left.
Three. Just three.
Right here. Stop running.
My hand clamps your shoulder — no letting go.

lines.zh: 冲力把我们两个都带倒了。
lines.en: The momentum takes us both down.

lines.zh: 我折起四肢，整个压下来。
lines.en: I fold my limbs and drop my full weight.
My limbs fold around you.
You push. I don't move.
I'm not even pressing.
This is the debt of speed.
You ran all night. Was it worth it.
Now you've stopped.
I can stop too.
My bones click. Very close.
You hear it clearly.
Don't move. It'll be quicker.

lines.zh: 我整只手盖住你的后颈。
lines.en: My whole hand covers the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的肩膀。
lines.en: My fingers lock onto your shoulder.
You ran far enough. This is the end.
I start moving first, and think later.
One push of the limbs and I'm gone.
The grass falls where I've run.

lines.zh: 这个速度，连我自己都不熟。
lines.en: I'm not even used to this speed.
I know I have to chase.
I don't know why.

lines.zh: 你听见的脆响，是我在爬。
lines.en: That brittle click you heard was me crawling.
That's me. Already fast.
Don't stand there.
Don't stand there. Run.
I count to three, and you run.
One. Run.
Two. Move.
Three. Here I come.
I'm on my way.

lines.zh: 我一跑起来，就不会减速。
lines.en: Once I run, I never slow.
Stop, and I'm there.

lines.zh: 骨头轻响一声，我从阴影里起身。
lines.en: My bones click once; I rise from the shadows.
Run further. Let me chase.
Let me chase a while longer.
Fire swept in. I ran through it.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下去，落地又跑。
lines.en: I fell from height and ran on landing.

lines.zh: 水里速度掉了一半，我还在追。
lines.en: Half my speed in water. Still chasing.

lines.zh: 震得我翻了一圈，接着跑。
lines.en: The blast flipped me. I kept running.

lines.zh: 有东西钉在我背上，不影响跑。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my back. Doesn't slow me.

lines.zh: 那光一照，我慢了，可只是一瞬。
lines.en: That light slowed me. Just for an instant.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，跑多久都行。
lines.en: I don't eat. I can run as long as needed.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我抽了一下，又跑。
lines.en: Lightning struck. I jerked and ran on.
No ground here to push off.
